name: Daily County-Level Counts
description: Daily county-level aggregate file with beneficiary counts, deaths, inpatient hospitalizations, rates, and demographic or coverage summaries where available.

content.year: Int32: Calendar year of the data
content.date: Date32[day]: Calendar date for the daily event counts
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths on the given date and geography
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of inpatient hospitalizations on the given date and geography
